title: Flow, Python and R pipeline
description: Three files, three languages, no data files: Flow simulates, Python reshapes, R models and plots. Run runs all three in order.
steps: Press Run. Run project executes the three files in order.
2_wrangle.py builds tidy rows and sends them to R as epidemic and peaks.
3_model.R fits early growth rates, checks them with Python, and plots all runs.
